summary: Iteration 3 (Session Amend) verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_session_amend.py — GET /api/drills returns 54 drills, PATCH /api/programs/:id/sessions/:week accepts drills[] and theme, recomputes total_minutes, clamps duration 1-60, auto-flags custom- prefixed ids as custom:true, ignores unknown fields, preserves completed/notes semantics, returns 404 on invalid week, requires auth (401). Frontend (Playwright, Sarah M program week 1): Amend Session button toggles edit mode which hides Complete/Print/Handout + Timer and reveals Cancel + Save Session + orange edit-banner with add-from-library-btn & add-custom-btn. drill-move-down-0 swaps drills 0<->1 (Dynamic Warm-Up <-> Jump Stop & Pivot). drill-remove-0 reduces count 3->2. Library modal (drill-picker-overlay) shows 54 items; drill-picker-cat-Shooting filters to 8 items; drill-picker-lvl-2 filters to 7 items; drill-picker-add-* appends and closes. Custom drill form adds drill with 'Coach's Own' tag. Save Session PATCHes and returns to normal view; refreshing page shows amended drills persist (4 total). Cancel discards unsaved additions.
critical_code_review_comments: SessionUpdate.drills is typed List[dict] — Pydantic won't validate shape; server sanitises manually which is fine but consider a DrillIn Pydantic model for stronger typing + auto-generated OpenAPI docs.
saveDrills refuses to save when draftDrills is empty — this prevents a coach from intentionally clearing a session; acceptable UX safeguard but consider a confirm dialog instead.
DrillPicker useEffect loads library only when open && library.length==0; if the underlying /api/drills is ever updated the client won't refetch during a session — minor.

CustomDrillForm resets local state after submit inside onSave→onClose but onSave is called before onClose; safe currently because form state is local. Consider using a controlled reset via useEffect on open toggling for robustness.

regression check: team roster path was not re-tested in this iteration but backend endpoint /api/teams/.../sessions/{week} is unchanged and team share the same program.sessions list — since PATCH mutates in-place, previously-added completions per player remain (they are stored on team.roster[].sessions, not on program.sessions), so amending drills does NOT wipe completion. Verified indirectly via test_teams.py still green in iteration 2.
